Class ObsBuilder

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.ObsBuilder
public final class ObsBuilder extends Object
Packs the pieces of an observation into the layout declared in ObsSpec.

    • writeActor

      public static void writeActor(Obs obs, MaskFrame frame, SightTracker sight, BodyState body, AimMotor motor, MixIdea idea, int[] lastAction, int headMask)
      Writes everything the acting network gets for one decision: the picture, where the opponent is on it (shifted by however far the camera has turned since the picture was taken), its own body, the camera hand, its plan, its last action and its controls. The same for a body on the screen and a body without one; only how frame and body were filled differs.

      Call once per decision: the sight tracker remembers the last sighting.

      Parameters:
      body - its own state now, with the hit clocks set
      lastAction - the action taken on the previous tick, or null at the start of an episode

    • writePrivileged

      public static void writePrivileged(float[] p, StepFacts facts, BodyState body, float relRight, float relUp, float relForward, float botHealth, float botCharge, boolean botSprinting, boolean botOnGround, boolean inReach, SessionClock clock, int stageIndex)
      Writes what only the critic gets: ground truth about the opponent. Never reaches the acting network.
      Parameters:
      relRight - ,relUp,relForward the opponent's eyes relative to the agent's, in the agent's horizontal view frame, blocks
      inReach - the crosshair is on the opponent and it is within reach

    • writeStage

      public static void writeStage(float[] priv, int stageIndex)
      Which task is being played, for the critic. The first eight stages are a one-hot; the ninth is no slot set and the tenth is every slot set, which keeps all ten apart in eight slots.
